xmldoc.short_description: Check a file against the EDF, EDF+, BDF and BDF+ specification.

param_input_item.param_description: with 'Fix', the path of a repaired copy.

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with valid (no problem found), type, problems (a cellstr of what breaks the format) and warnings (a cellstr of what is unusual but tolerated).

description.p: It checks the magic, the number of signals, the header byte count, the record duration, the physical and digital ranges and the record count against the file size, and, for a '+' file, the presence of an annotation channel; and it never throws, so it is the first thing to run on a file another tool wrote.

With 'Fix', dst it also writes a copy with the header byte count and the record count recomputed from the file itself, which repairs the two fields most often left wrong by a writer that stopped early.
